mapper.sql: select u.id, u.username, u.password, u.real_name as realName, u.role, u.dept_id as deptId, u.class_id as classId, d.dept_name as department, c.class_name as className from `user` u left join department d on u.dept_id = d.id left join sys_class c on u.class_id = c.id
mapper.insert: insert into `user` (username, password, real_name, role, dept_id, class_id) values (#{username}, #{password}, #{realName}, #{role}, #{deptId}, #{classId})
mapper.select: select id, username, real_name as realName, role, class_id as classId from `user` where class_id = #{classId} and role = 'STUDENT' order by id
select id, username, real_name as realName, role, dept_id as deptId from `user` where dept_id = #{deptId} and role = 'TEACHER' order by id
